card.name: Linking words before risk or calcium terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of" or "with" right before a named risk or substance, as in "large amounts of calcium" or "increased risk of infection". Also "Increased" in the heading "Immunosuppression and Increased Risk of Infection".

modes.label: Of after amounts
modes.description: The word "of" after "large amounts" and before calcium.
modes.example: Vitamin D supplementation should not be given with large amounts<< of>> calcium in those with hypercalcemia or

modes.label: Of after risk
modes.description: The word "of" after "risk" before an adverse effect such as infection or cataract.
modes.example: Topical corticosteroids may increase the risk<< of>> cataract and glaucoma formation

modes.label: Increased in heading
modes.description: The word "Increased" in the warning heading about immunosuppression and infection risk.
modes.example: hormone therapy should be reinstituted. Immunosuppression and<< Increased>> Risk of Infection Corticosteroids
